caption: The image depicts a drawing of a wooden figure that resembles a person. The figure has an oval-shaped head with faint facial features, including green eyes, a small mouth, and a light suggestion of a nose. It is wearing a gray or olive-colored hat, and its torso is painted in a matching color, resembling a jacket or shirt with a slight v-neck opening. The arms of the figure are jointed and angled outward and downward; they are brown and have extended red flags attached to the hands. The legs are straight, painted brown to resemble wood, and end at a horizontal base or platform. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the central figure.
title: Sailor Jack Whirligig
